# Claude Code Plugins Plus Skills Vendor Source

Upstream project: `jeremylongshore/claude-code-plugins-plus-skills`

Upstream URL: <https://github.com/jeremylongshore/claude-code-plugins-plus-skills.git>

Pinned source:

- Commit: `e773501f1dfb409fc71fccdaf6ac2898fedf66d6`
- License: MIT

This directory preserves the legally re-vendorable installable bundle surfaces
selected from the upstream repository. It is vendor custody material, not
first-party Harley-owned doctrine.

## Scope

Mirrored surfaces:

- `LICENSE`
- `plugins/packages/fullstack-starter-pack`
- `plugins/mcp/ai-experiment-logger`
- `plugins/mcp/conversational-api-debugger`
- `plugins/mcp/design-to-code`
- `plugins/mcp/domain-memory-agent`
- `plugins/mcp/lumera-agent-memory`
- `plugins/mcp/pr-to-spec`
- `plugins/mcp/project-health-auditor`
- `plugins/mcp/slack-channel`
- `plugins/mcp/workflow-orchestrator`
- `plugins/mcp/x-bug-triage`

Intentionally excluded from the mirror:

- `plugins/packages/ai-ml-engineering-pack`
- `plugins/packages/creator-studio-pack`
- `plugins/packages/devops-automation-pack`
- `plugins/packages/security-pro-pack`

Those package bundles carry local EULA text in their bundle `LICENSE` files and
are not re-vendored here.

The upstream `plugins/mcp/x-bug-triage-plugin` entry is treated as an alias of
`plugins/mcp/x-bug-triage` and is not mirrored as a separate directory.

## Provenance note
